recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not remove the additional MedicationRequest summary markers under FHIR-9978; any future R6 summary-set change should be a new Pharmacy work group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-9978 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and requested that MedicationOrder summary flags include only status, medication, patient, dateWritten, and prescriber.
initial_application: Historical commit 178b92d8e2a7bbe79da9412e8d74a28285d7aa0c explicitly lists gForge 9978 and adds summary markers for the requested MedicationOrder spreadsheet rows.
additional_context: MedicationOrder is no longer an active current resource; source/fhir.ini lists MedicationRequest as active and records the MedicationPrescription-to-MedicationRequest transition plus legacy MedicationOrder mappings. Later R5-era source migration, FHIR-32487 element ordering, and FHIR-24100 workflow reconciliation retained the requested descendant elements and also carried current workflow/request summary fields.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current MedicationRequest has summary markers for status, medication, subject, authoredOn, and requester/prescriber-equivalent, and its additional workflow summary markers are supported by later current-resource history and peer request-resource patterns.
